name: WIN Lander
author: gigabyte_games
description: Welcome to WIN Lander. In this educational and interactive game you can help a lander make a safe landing on the moon. After that you can explore the lunar terrain. Instructions: To land the lander use the arrow keys to maneuver over the rocky surface. When exploring use WASD/Arrow Keys to move, use your mouse to look around and Spacebar to jump. Also you can collect samples of the lunar soil by pressing A. Thank You.
